note: Issue #215: chapters land -> general -> t89 -> meet_oda -> range -> remote -> smuggle_1 -> droid_merchant -> bounty -> fleet -> debrief (issue #303) -> end -> free. 'done_on' may be a list: any of its events ends the chapter. 'modes': the save modes a chapter is in (default all; land, general and t89 are story only, so a freeplay story starts at meet_oda). 'chapter_renames': old chapter ids a save may hold. Issue #64: the main story line. Issue #193: 'done_flag': a chapter whose flag is already set when it starts is over at once (the cruiser taken before Oda asked). 'pays': credits the teller hands over with the intro. Read by src/systems/flow/story.gd. Chapters run in order; each one ends on a game event ('done_on', reported to Story.event()). 'intro' is what the teller says the first time you talk to them in that chapter (it replaces their greeting), 'remind' what they say on later visits while it is still open. 'job' puts that job's card in front of the player with the line. T-89 (the droid in the pit) points you at Oda; Oda tells every other chapter. The last chapter ('free') never ends: smuggling runs and bounty contracts on repeat.

chapters.note: Issue #202: the opening. The autopilot brings your ship down into the pit; E gets you out (ShipPilot.opening_landing).

chapters.intro: I'm amazed you were able to land this piece of garbage. Looks like you got into some trouble on your flight home? Well, now you're subject to Hegemony rule, search and seizure. State your business.
chapters.remind: Still here? State your business, or get out of my sight.

chapters.intro: Do not mind the general, pilot. I was fixing ships in this pit before there was a war to lose. Before you go anywhere, let me show you how things work here, and then go and see Oda Vell at the cantina: she has work.
One more thing, pilot: walk up to the cantina at the far end of town and talk to Oda Vell. Nothing happens in this port without her hearing about it first.
chapters.remind: Oda Vell is waiting at the cantina, at the far end of town. Go and talk to her.

chapters.intro: New face, and you want work. First, get some practice in. There's a range down in the landing pit: shoot a few targets, then come back and see me.
chapters.remind: The range is in the pit. Go and shoot something that isn't a customer, then come back.

chapters.intro: Practice is practice: here's forty for your trouble. One more thing down in the pit, if you're up to it. There's a sparring droid by the range that takes shots at you. Block five in a row with a blade and it'll follow you home. Go on, then come back for real work.
chapters.remind: The sparring droid's in the pit. Five blocks in a row and it's yours. Or don't; just come back when you've had a look.

chapters.intro: Not bad. Here's real work: a drop for the fence in the market. Find it, keep it away from the Remnant at the front gate, sell it. And a tip: that old cargo droid rolling round the pit has a jetpack inside it. Open it up. Nobody's going to miss it.
chapters.remind: The drop's still out there, or still in your pockets. Get it to the fence. And open that cargo droid in the pit, if you haven't: there's a jetpack in it.
chapters.jetpack_hint: If the player asks about getting over walls or about gear, remind them the old cargo droid in the pit has a jetpack inside it.

chapters.intro: A friend of mine is in need of three cargo droids. You could buy them, or fix some up in the desert. Take them to any of the droid merchants' posts out there. Get that done and I'll tell you about an incredible weapon.
chapters.remind: My friend still needs %d more cargo droids. Any droid merchant's post in the desert will take them.

chapters.intro: My friend's happy, so here's the weapon: somebody stashed an energy blade up on top of this cantina's tower, and it's still there. Climb up and take it. Now, two things. If you need to cross the desert, Skrugs sells speeders by the back gate, out behind this cantina. And there's a bounty.
chapters.remind: The bounty's still open. Do it, then collect from the fence in the market.

chapters.note: Issue #64/#193: the space mission is the general on the Remnant cruiser's bridge, far out east in orbit. The fleet's fighters (the cruiser's escort) meet you on the way up; beating them is not the mission.
chapters.intro: That made noise. The Remnant has its fleet up in orbit now, round a star cruiser way out east, and the general who runs every Remnant on this rock never leaves its bridge. The locals will pay twenty thousand to see him dead. Take your own ship up, land in the cruiser's bay and kill him. Expect fighters on the way up. If you haven't got a ship, T-89 in the pit will see you right.
chapters.remind: The general's still up there on the cruiser's bridge, far out east past the curve. Take your own ship up, land in its bay and kill him. Expect fighters on the way.

chapters.note: Issue #303: the general is dead and paid for (the save was written on the spot). Go back to Oda: her telling ends the chapter and the end card follows. On the dark master's oath, clearing the barracks' local guards ends it instead (the dark ending); telling Oda first breaks the oath (DarkPact).
chapters.intro: So he's dead. Twenty thousand from the locals, and nobody in this port will let you buy your own drink again. The Remnant's finished here: their fleet's breaking up and the garrison's packing. Sit down a minute. You've earned it.
chapters.remind: The general's dead. Come and see me at the cantina.

chapters.note: Issue #214: the end card (EndCard); closing it ends the chapter.

chapters.intro: So that's it: the Remnant's gone from this moon. Go find one of the native tribes and trade, upgrade your gear, and explore the moon base. There's always another drop for the fence, and now and then somebody wants a Remnant dead.
chapters.intro_dark: So the Remnant hold the barracks again, and the guards who stood on it are dead. I don't ask where people's money comes from. The fence still buys, and now and then somebody still wants a Remnant dead.

end_card.title: THE REMNANT LEAVE THE MOON
end_card.general_dead: Their fleet broken and their general dead, the last of the Remnant pack up the barracks and lift off at dawn. Nobody waves. The port has its gate back, and you have a ship of your own.
end_card.general_alive: Their fleet broken, the Remnant lift off at dawn. All but one: the general stays, out of uniform in the desert armour, still haunting the barracks and still buying droids. The port has its gate back, and you have a ship of your own.
end_card.dark: The locals' guards lie dead in the barracks yard, and by nightfall the Remnant's black and red flies over the gate again. Their fleet is broken and their general is dead, but something darker leads them now, and it remembers who opened the door. The port is theirs. So, for now, are you.

objectives.note: The HUD's objective pointer and the job log on I (src/systems/flow/objective.gd). 'chapters' is what each story chapter wants once Oda has told it; until she has, the pointer says 'teller'. 'target' is where the arrow points: npc:<marker> (a live body, else its marker), marker:<town marker>, drop:<area marker> (issue #251: a spot within 15 m of the smuggling drop, the area's marker until it is placed), range, remote (the sparring droid), pad (the pit), outpost:<location id>, fence (the town's contraband buyer), cruiser (issue #193: its bay from outside, its general once aboard), droid_post (issue #212: the nearest desert droid merchant's post). The jobs' lines take the job's own words (%s). Issue #251: a 'general_' line is the smuggling-run line in the general's words, while his run (contraband inside the town, handed to him) is on.

teller.text: Talk to Oda at the cantina

t89.text: Talk to T-89, the droid in the pit

meet_oda.text: Find Oda Vell at the cantina, far end of town

range.text: Shoot the targets at the range in the landing pit

remote.text: Try the sparring droid in the pit, then go back to Oda

droid_merchant.text: Take cargo droids to the nearest droid merchant's post

fleet.text: Fly to the Remnant cruiser, far east in orbit, and kill the general on its bridge

debrief.text: Go back to Oda at the cantina

dark_oath.text: Clear the local guards from the barracks of {town}

objectives.sell: Sell the goods to the fence
objectives.general_bring: Hand the contraband to General Vask at the barracks
objectives.collect: Collect the bounty on %s from the fence
objectives.log_drop: Somebody left %s %s. Keep it away from the gate.
objectives.log_carry: You have the goods. Sell them to the fence, and keep them away from the Remnant at the gate.
objectives.general_log_drop: Smugglers stashed %s %s. Repossess it for the general.
objectives.general_log_carry: You have the contraband. Hand it to General Vask at the barracks: the garrison will put it to better use.
objectives.log_collect: %s is dead. Collect %d cr from the fence.
objectives.log_none: Nothing on. Oda always has something.

quests_note: Issue #201: optional quests (src/systems/flow/quests.gd), in the job log under 'log_quests'. Each is offered on its 'unlocked_by' event and done on its 'done_on' (any Story.event name), with a 5 s toast ('quest_toast') when it is new. 'target' is a pointer target word as in objectives ("" = nowhere to point yet). No waypoint until the player switches it on in the log. Issue #303: '{town}' in a quest's text is the town's name, and a quest can fail (the dark master's oath, broken by telling Oda's debrief first).

quests.title: Rebuild your ship
quests.text: T-89 can rebuild your wreck in the pit for 500 cr. Less, if he likes you.

quests.title: Steal a rifle
quests.text: The guards keep guns lying around on top of the barracks. Nobody would miss one.

quests.title: Trade with the nomads
quests.text: The nomad packs out in the desert trade anything for sand pig: a blaster for 5, armour for 12. Keep your gun down for a minute and they warm up.

quests.title: The blade on the cantina tower
quests.text: Oda says there's an energy blade stashed up on the cantina tower.

quests.title: Work for the general
quests.text: General Vask says outlanders like you will take any work, and he has something in mind. Ask him for work at the barracks.

quests.title: The crashed cruiser
quests.text: The general says the old cruiser in the sand is worth a look. Something red is still aboard.

quests.title: The dark master's oath
quests.text: Clear the local guards from the barracks of {town}. They still think you're on their side. Going back to Oda first breaks the oath.

ship_locked: Locked. The keys aren't yours to take yet.
ship_wreck: Your ship. A wreck: T-89 in the pit can rebuild it.
ship_not_yours: Not yours. No keys, no flight.

bounty.general_crime: He's run this port for the Remnant since the day the Hegemony fell, and half the graves outside the gate are his doing. He's out at the outpost inspecting the troops.
bounty.killed_toast: %s is dead. Collect the bounty from the fence.
bounty.offer: There's a price on %s, a Remnant officer at the %s. %s Kill them and the fence pays %d.
bounty.event_killed: %s, a Remnant officer, was found dead at an outpost in the desert.
bounty.event_general: %s, the Remnant general, was shot dead in the barracks yard.
crimes: They burned a water hauler's tanks so a whole street went dry for a week.
They shot a fisherman's boy for walking past the gate after curfew.
They sold the town's medicine to the highest bidder and kept the money.
They ordered a cantina full of people locked in while their troopers looted the street.
They hanged three locals for a theft their own sergeant committed.
They sealed a mine with the crew still in it rather than pay them.
They taxed a widow's stall until she starved, then took the stall.
